content_zh:
即将走出大门的邢烨停下脚步，回头看向加西亚公爵，这位贵族正牢牢盯着他不放。
当然要出门，否则女王男宠要怎么联系他。
通过这些日子的观察，邢烨确定公爵府的防卫如铁桶一般，滴水不漏，一个女王的眼线都没有。这种情况下，操纵者就算想联系他也不容易。为了给敌人机会。邢烨不得不以逛街为理由每天在街上晃悠。
“我从未见过这样繁华的城市，”邢烨回答道，“公爵大人再过几日就回封地了吧？在此之前，我希望能够好好看一看皇城，毕竟下一次来就不知是什么时候了。”
“我回封地是为了处理今年春耕的事情，”加西亚公爵说道，“我在皇城有公务，每年只有春耕和丰收祭才会回到封地，你不必心急，还会再来的。”
是这样吗？看来加西亚公爵不仅是大贵族，还兼任着国事，是个有实权的贵族，实力不可小觑。
“只是去看看。”邢烨尽量模仿出小地方的人对大都市向往的表情。
加西亚有些无奈地摇摇头：“你半个月前女王生日当天斩杀了皇族侍卫长，皇城总归是女王的领地，如果你在街上被抓，就算是我也有点为难。”
“我很强。”邢烨握住了剑柄。
“我不是这个意思……哎……”加西亚公爵从怀中拿出一个怀表递给邢烨，“这是480年前女王赐给加西亚家族的信物，上面有女王的印章，我暂时将它借给你，若是遇到危险就亮出怀表，一般人不敢伤害你的。”
“多谢公爵。”邢烨不客气地接过怀表，女王今年500岁，480年前大概正是她黑化的时期，怀表明显是任务道具，他当然要拿。
“遇到想买的东西可以记在加西亚家族名下，让店家明天来府里结账。”加西亚公爵又嘱咐一句。
“我没什么想买的。”邢烨干脆地拒绝，带着怀表出门了。
这倔强的女孩……加西亚摇摇头，派沃克骑士暗中跟着邢烨，保护他的安全就好，不用打扰她。
邢烨自然清楚有人在跟踪他，他并不在意，确切地说这正中他的下怀。
他仔细地观察怀表，确定怀表不像镜子，并没有灵魂在其中，只是道具而已。
虽说是怀表，但它已经坏掉了，时针与分针凝固在六点零六分，无论怎么调整都不动，似乎在暗示女王不变的容颜。
将重要道具揣好，邢烨按计划走到与男宠约定的地方。
他每次出门都会做一些引起皇族护卫队注意的事情，刻意让男宠知道自己的行踪。钓鱼钓了几日后，邢烨确定今天男宠会想办法出宫见他。
沃克骑士的跟踪是意外，但也不坏，说不定会有更好的结果出现。

到了约定的漆黑的四下无人的小巷中，注意到沃克骑士藏在一个角落中，邢烨特意在一个沃克只能看到一点点的位置等待男宠。
过了一会儿，男宠出现了，他生得极为俊朗，不是小白脸那种英俊，而是宛若将士一般的俊朗，一看某方面能力就特别好。
“我没想到你竟然敢大摇大摆在街上晃，不怕被侍卫队抓住动私刑吗？”男宠靠近邢烨，用只有两人能听到的声音低声道。
“还好，我对自己的实力有信心。”邢烨也低声说，“我们明人不说暗话，你是来帮我靠近女王的吧？你是女王的枕边人，带人进宫很容易。”
“你怎么知道？”男宠惊讶道。
邢烨笑笑：“我还知道你要告诉我，你没有恶意，只是受够了伺候一个五百岁的老女人。你无法反抗游戏安排的身份，必须履行一名男宠的义务，且不允许自杀。两个同伴死了，我这么厉害，你现在一心只想离开这个世界，至少不要再忍受被魔鬼附身的女王，所以才会选择与我合作，对吗？”
“你、你、你……怎么会……”男宠倒退两步，发现后面是墙壁，他根本逃不开。
“别太惊讶，请君入瓮是你现在唯一能想出的办法，不难猜到。”邢烨胸有成竹地说道，“而且你献身女王的事情应该也是真的，所以欺骗起来会更有说服力，半真半假才是骗人的最高境界。”
男宠觉得自己像是被邢烨扒光了一般，没有一点秘密，惊得说不出话来。
一直以来，操纵者们躲在幕后，从未见过自己的对手是什么样子。在他们看来，已经占尽优势的己方是不可能输的。

content_en:
Xing Ye, who was about to walk out of the door, stopped and looked back at Duke Garcia. The nobleman was staring at him closely.
Of course he has to go out, otherwise how would the Queen's male favorite contact him?
Through these days of observation, Xing Ye determined that the defense of the Duke's Palace was like an iron bucket, watertight, and there was not even a single spy from the Queen. In this case, it is not easy for the manipulator to contact him even if he wants to. To give the enemy a chance. Xing Ye had to use shopping as an excuse to wander around the streets every day.
"I have never seen such a prosperous city," Xing Ye replied. "The Duke will return to his fiefdom in a few days, right? Before that, I hope to take a good look at the imperial city. After all, I don't know when the next time I will come."
"I returned to the fiefdom to deal with this year's spring plowing," Duke Garcia said. "I have official duties in the imperial city. I only return to the fiefdom every year for spring plowing and harvest festivals. You don't have to be anxious, I will come again."
Is that so? It seems that Duke Garcia is not only a great nobleman, but also in charge of state affairs. He is a nobleman with real power and his strength cannot be underestimated.
"Just going to have a look." Xing Ye tried his best to imitate the expression of a person from a small place yearning for a big city.
Garcia shook his head helplessly: "You killed the royal guard chief on the queen's birthday half a month ago. The imperial city is always the queen's territory. If you were caught on the street, even I would be in a bit of trouble."
"I'm very strong." Xing Ye held the hilt of the sword.
"That's not what I meant... Hey..." Duke Garcia took out a pocket watch from his arms and handed it to Xing Ye, "This is a token given to the Garcia family by the Queen 480 years ago. It has the Queen's seal on it. I will lend it to you temporarily. If you are in danger, show your pocket watch. Most people will not dare to hurt you."
"Thank you, Duke." Xing Ye took the pocket watch unceremoniously. The Queen is 500 years old this year, and it was probably the time when she turned black 480 years ago. The pocket watch was obviously a mission prop, so of course he had to take it.
"When you encounter something you want to buy, you can put it in the name of the Garcia family and ask the store owner to come to the house to settle the bill tomorrow." Duke Garcia asked again.
"I have nothing to buy." Xing Ye simply refused and went out with his pocket watch.
This stubborn girl... Garcia shook his head and sent Knight Walker to follow Xing Ye secretly to protect his safety without disturbing her.
Xing Ye naturally knew that someone was following him, but he didn't care. To be precise, this was exactly what he wanted.
He carefully observed the pocket watch and determined that it was not like a mirror and had no soul in it, it was just a prop.
Although it is a pocket watch, it is broken. The hour and minute hands are frozen at six o'clock and six, and they do not move no matter how much they are adjusted, which seems to imply the Queen's unchanging appearance.
After putting away the important props, Xing Ye walked to the place agreed with his male favorite as planned.
Every time he goes out, he does something to attract the attention of the royal guards, deliberately letting his male favorite know his whereabouts. After fishing for a few days, Xing Ye was sure that his male favorite would find a way to get out of the palace to see him today.
Walker Knight's tracking was unexpected, but it wasn't bad. Maybe there would be better results.
When they arrived at the promised dark and deserted alley, they noticed Knight Walker hiding in a corner. Xing Ye deliberately waited for his male favorite in a position where Walker could only see a little bit.
After a while, the male favorite appeared. He was extremely handsome. He was not as handsome as a pretty boy, but as handsome as a soldier. He was particularly good at certain abilities.
"I didn't expect you to dare to walk around in the street so arrogantly. Aren't you afraid of being caught and lynched by the guards?" The male favorite approached Xing Ye and whispered in a voice that only the two of them could hear.
"Fortunately, I have confidence in my own strength." Xing Ye also whispered, "We Mingren don't talk secretly. Are you here to help me get closer to the queen? You are the queen's pillow, and it is easy to bring people into the palace."
"How do you know?" The male favorite asked in surprise.
Xing Ye smiled: "I also knew you were going to tell me that you meant no harm but were simply fed up with serving a five-hundred-year-old woman. You cannot resist the identity arranged by the game, you must fulfill the obligations of a male favorite, and suicide is not allowed. Two companions are dead. I am so powerful. Now you just want to leave this world. At least you don't have to endure the queen who is possessed by the devil. That's why you choose to cooperate with me, right? "
"You, you, you... how could you..." The male favorite took two steps back and found that there was a wall behind him, and he couldn't escape at all.
"Don't be too surprised. Inviting you into the urn is the only way you can think of now. It's not difficult to guess. "Xing Ye said confidently, "And the fact that you dedicated yourself to the queen should be true, so deception will be more convincing. Half-truth and half-falsehood are the highest level of deception. "
The male favorite felt as if he had been stripped naked by Xing Ye, without any secrets, and was so shocked that he could not speak.
All this time, the manipulators have hidden behind the scenes, never seeing what their opponents look like. In their view, it is impossible for their side to lose, having already gained all the advantages.
